adapter_policy.cross_batch_deduplication: Skip candidates matching any existing RII source ID, canonical raw source URL, or labeled raw source SHA256.
adapter_policy.defaults: All imported groups remain optional and are appended; no built-in constant or default is overwritten.
adapter_policy.formula_sources: Full upstream formula and generated sampling evidence remain in this archive; no unmapped formula candidate enters the calculation catalog.
adapter_policy.material_mapping: Unique exact chemical formula plus exact film role against current built-in material profiles.
adapter_policy.n_only: A source without k is imported with k=null; no zero values are inferred.
